nodes.label: OneFlow PWA app icon (192x192)
nodes.description: OneFlow progressive web app icon at 192x192 resolution. Features a teal/cyan vertical gradient background, a small red/coral square accent in the top-left corner, and a white '1F' wordmark centered in the middle. The '1' is bold and stylized with a flag-like top, the 'F' is lighter weight. Serves as the standard PWA icon size for installation on mobile and desktop.
